description: This file defines the deprecated interface IController for controlling plugin-host related functionalities such as persistence, deletion, reboot, environment, configuration, and cloning within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: A deprecated interface for controlling plugin host operations, providing methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning of plugin callsigns.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists current state or data related to the controller.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes resources specified by the given path.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the controller or associated system.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables or information associated with a given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration associated with a specified callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin or component from a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
